findings.summary: _load_index still drops the persisted lancedb table and re-embeds every page synchronously inside WikiStore.__init__, so each server start issues one embedding request per page against the configured production endpoint with no incremental reuse of the on-disk vector table. Startup cost and index availability scale linearly with corpus size. This is a scaling observation, not a spec violation: §6 only mandates an injectable embedder (satisfied via FakeEmbeddingClient), network-failure coverage (satisfied via ErrorEmbeddingClient), and a --rebuild-index command (present); the spec does not require incremental reuse on startup. Carried forward unchanged from the previous Final review.
